label: D1 after a reward, when the agent is about to choose a2 (mid/late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2) and only when the reward input is 1. 97.5% of its mass is on steps where the agent is about to choose a2 (choice logit negative), so it reads as rewarded and about to go with a2. The only FUTURE variable is action, which at D1 is the agent s own upcoming choice. That is legitimate: the observed-only proxy, choice < 0, gets mass recall 0.87. (phase==D1)&(in_rew==1)&(action==2) alone has recall 0.97 but precision 0.43 (dev F1 0.59). Precision is strongly modulated by absolute episode position: the firing rate peaks on trials 50-79, is low before trial 40 and near zero after trial 85, so adding 40<=ep_trial<85 raises dev F1 to 0.75 (mass recall 0.68). Magnitude is largest on the first reward after an unrewarded trial, e.g. right after a rare or unrewarded a2 trial: with reward(-2)==0 recall is 0.25 but mass recall 0.42. During long streaks of rewarded a2 it is weak or silent. It does not fire on unrewarded D1 or on rewarded D1 before an a1 choice (2.5% of mass).
